system.description:
Increase the vehicle's Handling by +1; this is added to your skill check when you make maneuvers. Handling cannot be increased above +2.

Each modification raises the vehicle's cost by one multiplier level (when the die reaches its maximum multiplier, the die grows a size instead); no vehicle may exceed d12x6 R.D. Added after the vehicle is acquired, each modification costs d6 R.D.
